services.seoTitle: How car painting works at Mpaint
services.seoP1: Every repaint starts with an assessment of the damage and a read of your car's factory colour code. We prepare and sand the panel, apply primer, then spray base coat and lacquer inside a dedicated paint booth where filtered air and controlled temperature keep dust out of the finish.
services.seoP2: We paint single panels as well as full cars. Painting one door, bumper or wing is usually enough after a parking scrape, while corrosion or accident damage across several panels is better handled as a larger job. If the paint on your car has faded unevenly, we blend into the neighbouring panels so the repair does not stand out.
services.seoP3: Alongside painting we handle welding and sheet metal repair, rust removal and anti-corrosion treatment, spotter dent pulling, body and headlight polishing, and replacement of body parts. If your repair goes through insurance, we can help with the paperwork.

faq.q: Can a scratch be repaired without repainting the whole panel?
faq.a: Sometimes, yes. It depends on how deep the scratch is and the condition of the paint layer.

faq.q: Can a dent be removed without repainting?
faq.a: Yes, if the paint layer is intact and the damage allows for paintless dent removal.
We remove the affected area, repair the metal if needed, and prepare the surface for repainting.

faq.q: Can a rusted part always be repaired?
faq.a: Not always. A severely damaged or fully rusted-through part may need partial or full replacement.

faq.q: How is the new paint matched to the existing colour?
faq.a: We start from your car's factory colour code and check the tone against the existing paintwork.

faq.q: Can plastic bumpers be repaired and painted?
faq.a: Yes. Whether it's possible depends on the extent of any cracks, deformation, or other damage.

faq.q: Do you also paint whole cars?
faq.a: Yes, we paint individual parts as well as larger areas and full cars.
The surface is cleaned, sanded, repaired and primed according to its condition.

faq.q: What bodywork services do you offer?
faq.a: We repair dents, rust and body damage, carry out welding, and prepare surfaces for painting.

faq.q: How long does the work take?
faq.a: It depends on the extent of the damage, the preparation needed, and the scope of the repair.
